title: 4th Bronze Medalist (Ranked 7th Nationally) - Robotics Level 4 Kompetisi Sains Siswa Muslim Indonesia 2025
bullets: Awarded the 4th Bronze Medal (Ranked 7th overall) in the Robotics Level 4 (High School division) at the Kompetisi Sains Siswa Muslim Indonesia (KoSSMI 2025), with the Grand Final hosted at Sekolah Vokasi IPB University, Bogor.

project during the preliminary round, utilizing an Arduino Uno (programmed via Arduino IDE) to integrate a vehicle air pollution filtration system powered by renewable energy from pedestrian footsteps via piezoelectric sensors.
Successfully advanced through rigorous national eliminations, outperforming 49 competing teams in the preliminary video and source-code selection to reach the top 25 semifinalists.

Secured a spot as one of the top 10 grand finalists to compete offline at IPB after delivering a comprehensive 15-minute live project presentation and defending the design during the jury Q&A session.
Demonstrated advanced robotics programming and autonomous navigation during the Grand Final by coding a
robot from scratch to execute a precise mission: retrieving 3 miniature pipes, depositing them into a designated container, and executing an automated parking sequence.
